description: Mixes a Sapphire Echo chain down to its stereo or polyphonic output, and goes to the right of the last Echo Tap

params.text: Balances dry against processed audio, fully dry counter-clockwise and fully processed clockwise
Attenuates and inverts the mix CV
Sets the overall output volume of the chain, dry and processed together
Attenuates and inverts the output level CV

inputs.text: Moves the balance between dry and processed audio
Varies the overall output volume of the chain

outputs.text: Left audio out of the whole chain; in polyphonic mode this port carries every channel
Right audio out of the whole chain; in polyphonic mode it carries one channel of 0V

notes: this expander has no effect by itself: place it to the right of the last Echo Tap, or of Echo, and the whole chain then comes out of its ports.
deleting this module leaves the chain with no output; pressing the add-tap button on the last tap of a chain that has no Echo Out inserts one.
menu: Low sensitivity — on an attenuverter knob's own menu, not the panel menu: divides that knob's effect by 10 and marks the knob with an orange dot
Unipolar mode — on an attenuverter knob's own menu, not the panel menu: adds 5V to the CV on that control and clamps the result at zero

inputs.0:
continuous · polyphonic

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to ±10V.
inputs.1:
continuous · polyphonic

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to ±5V.
